# IITDeveloper — Digital Engineering Studio & Cloud Infrastructure Lab

Digital Engineering Studio building scalable web applications, generative AI workflows, and resilient cloud infrastructure.

## Core Services
- **Website & App Development** (/services/website-development): Professional custom website development services. We build fast, scalable, and beautiful web applications with modern frameworks like Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
- **Mobile App Development** (/services/app-development): Professional mobile app development for iOS and Android. Native and cross-platform apps that users love. React Native, Flutter, Swift, and Kotlin expertise.
- **DevOps & Cloud** (/services/devops-cloud): Professional DevOps and cloud infrastructure services. CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, and cloud architecture on AWS, GCP, and Azure.
- **AI Agents** (/services/ai-agents): Custom AI agents that automate complex workflows. Autonomous, intelligent, and available 24/7. Built with modern LLMs and agent frameworks.
- **AI Workflows** (/services/ai-workflows): Custom LLM integrations and AI automation systems. MCP protocols, intelligent pipelines, and workflow automation that scales.
- **Salesforce Solutions** (/services/salesforce): Expert Salesforce consulting and custom implementations. CRM optimization, integrations, custom apps, and automation that makes Salesforce work for your business.
- **Shopify Store** (/services/shopify-store): Expert Shopify store creation — custom themes, app integrations, payment setup, and full launch support. We build Shopify stores that convert and scale.
- **Performance Marketing** (/services/marketing): Data-driven performance marketing that converts. PPC campaigns, social ads, conversion optimization, and growth marketing that stops burning money.
- **SEO & Social Media** (/services/seo-smm): SEO and social media marketing that works in 2026. Get found on Google, grow your following, and drive organic traffic that converts.
- **Ecommerce Solutions** (/services/ecommerce): Full-stack ecommerce development with payment gateways, marketplace integrations, brand architecture, and retention strategies. Built to sell, engineered to scale.
- **Graphic Design & Video** (/services/graphic-design): Professional graphic design — posters, banners, video editing, 2D animations, After Effects motion graphics, and online/offline marketing materials.
- **B2B Promotion** (/services/b2b-promotion): End-to-end B2B growth strategies. Market research, lead generation, content marketing, and analytics that fill pipelines and close deals.

## Featured Products & Ecosystem
- **Sendrin** (https://sendrin.com): Enterprise multi-tenant communication and notification engine.
- **IITD IAM** (https://iam.iitdeveloper.com): Central identity provider with RFC 7636 PKCE.
- **Growixa** (https://growixa.com): Growth engineering, lead intake, and marketing automation.

## Quick Contact
- Website: https://iitdeveloper.com
- Inquiries: info@iitdeveloper.com
- Intake: https://iitdeveloper.com/contact

# About IITDeveloper

To empower organizations worldwide through resilient digital engineering, ethical AI systems, and high-performance cloud infrastructure that accelerates human potential.

## Studio Milestones & Stats
- **Founded**: 2019
- **Growth Professionals**: 50+
- **Years Experience**: 6+
- **Registered 2020**: MSME

## Core Engineering Values
### Cutting-Edge Technologies
The secret to success is to offer cutting-edge technologies. Always choose the better product with the most effective platform, whether that means using the cloud for scalability, putting DevOps into practice for efficiency, or developing creative digital marketing efforts.

### Client-Centric Approach
We are primarily focused on your success. Our solutions are customized after we take the time to comprehend your particular objectives and difficulties. As a valued partner on a quest to achieve exceptional digital transformations, you are more than just a client while working with IIT Developer.

### Your End-to-End Solution Provider
At IIT Developer, we deliver complete solutions rather than simply services. We can help you develop a game-changing product, increase your online presence, use DevOps to streamline operations, or take advantage of cloud computing.

## Contact & Hubs
- Email: info@iitdeveloper.com
- Address: San Francisco, CA, US

# Verified Case Studies & Production Portfolio

IITDeveloper track record across delivered enterprise systems:
- **Projects Delivered**: 100+
- **Client Satisfaction**: 98%
- **Average Rating**: 4.9★
- **On-Time Delivery**: 100%

## Featured Case Studies
### BiteBreak — Smart Cafeteria System
- **Client/Domain**: Corporate Cafeterias (Mobile & Kitchen System)
- **Overview**: A multi-role cafeteria ordering and kitchen management platform with real-time ticket queues, nutritional tracking, and store analytics. Interactive live prototype available.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Python, Docker, SQLite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Outcomes**: Role Workspaces: 3 Roles (Synced); Queue Sync: <100ms (Real-time); Throughput: 3x Faster (+200%)
- **URL**: /case-studies/bitebreak

### PulsarIP — Intellectual Property Platform
- **Client/Domain**: PulsarIP Legal (Legaltech Platform)
- **Overview**: An intellectual property and corporate legal services portal with digital trademark & patent filing workflows, legal consultancy booking, and automated compliance tracking.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Cloud Infrastructure, Analytics
- **Outcomes**: Practice Areas: 12+ (Full Scope); Consultation SLA: 24hr (Guaranteed); Client Trust: Enterprise (Verified)
- **URL**: https://pulsarip.com

### Sendrin — Enterprise Notification & Messaging Engine
- **Client/Domain**: Internal Product & Enterprise Clients (Cloud Communications Platform)
- **Overview**: A high-throughput multi-tenant communication platform routing transactional email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages with real-time delivery telemetry and Keycloak SSO.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, FastAPI, Keycloak, Redis, Docker, Caddy
- **Outcomes**: Throughput: 10k+ msgs/min (High Volume); Delivery Rate: 99.9% (Zero Drop); Latency: <250ms (Real-time)
- **URL**: https://sendrin.com

# AI Agents & Automation — IITDeveloper

Custom AI agents that automate complex workflows. Autonomous, intelligent, and available 24/7. Built with modern LLMs and agent frameworks.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom AI Agents**: Agents tailored to your business logic. Not generic chatbots.
- **Multi-Model Support**: GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, or custom models. Best tool for each task.
- **24/7 Availability**: Works while you sleep. No sick days. No vacation requests.
- **Natural Conversations**: Context-aware dialogue. Remembers conversations. Actually helpful.
- **Learning & Improvement**: Gets smarter over time. Learns from interactions and feedback.
- **Fast Integration**: Plug into existing systems. APIs, webhooks, databases.

## Supported Technologies & Frameworks
- OpenAI GPT-4
- Claude 3.5
- Google Gemini
- LangChain
- Vector Databases
- Pinecone
- Weaviate
- LlamaIndex
- Function Calling
- RAG Systems
- Fine-tuning
- Prompt Engineering

## Delivery & Engineering Process
01. **Use Case Discovery**: We identify repetitive tasks that AI can handle better than humans.
02. **Agent Architecture**: Design the agent logic, knowledge base, and integration points.
03. **Development & Training**: Build the agent, configure prompts, and connect to your data sources.
04. **Testing & Refinement**: Rigorous testing with edge cases and unexpected inputs.
05. **Deployment & Monitoring**: Launch the agent with full monitoring, analytics, and fallback mechanisms.
06. **Continuous Learning**: Regular updates and improvements based on real conversation data.

## Engagement & Next Steps
- **Consultation**: Free consultation. We explore how AI agents can save your team 20+ hours a week.

- **Data Pipelines**: Intelligent data processing pipelines with AI at every step.
- **Real-Time Processing**: Stream processing and real-time AI decision making.
- **Secure & Compliant**: Enterprise-grade security. Your data stays your data.

- LlamaIndex
- MCP Protocol

- Vector Stores
- Redis
- Kafka
- Airflow
- Prefect
- n8n

03. **Model Orchestration**: Connect vector stores, RAG retrieval engines, and fine-tuned prompts.

# SEO, SMM & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) — IITDeveloper

SEO and social media marketing that works in 2026. Get found on Google, grow your following, and drive organic traffic that converts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Technical SEO**: Site speed, structured data, Core Web Vitals. The technical foundation that ranks.
- **On-Page Optimization**: Content optimization, keyword strategy, and internal linking that works.
- **Link Building**: High-quality backlinks from real sites. No spam, no PBNs, no shortcuts.
- **Social Media Strategy**: Platform-specific content strategies. Not just posting, actually engaging.
- **Community Growth**: Real followers, real engagement. No bots, no fake accounts.
- **Content Marketing**: Content that ranks, content that converts. SEO + social + conversion.

## Supported Technologies & Frameworks
- Ahrefs
- SEMrush
- Google Search Console
- Screaming Frog
- SurferSEO
- Buffer
- Hootsuite
- Canva
- Google Analytics
- Schema.org
- PageSpeed Insights
- BuzzSumo

## Delivery & Engineering Process
01. **Technical & Content Audit**: Identify indexation blockers, schema omissions, Core Web Vitals issues, and content gaps.
02. **Keyword & Semantic Strategy**: Target high-intent search queries and AI engine answer topics.
03. **On-Page & Architecture Fixes**: Optimize page structure, meta tags, and internal link equity.
04. **Authority & Link Building**: Acquire high-authority editorial links through genuine digital PR.
05. **Tracking & Compounding Growth**: Monitor search impressions, keyword rankings, and organic conversions.

# Shopify Store Development — IITDeveloper

Expert Shopify store creation — custom themes, app integrations, payment setup, and full launch support. We build Shopify stores that convert and scale.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom Theme Design**: Pixel-perfect Shopify themes built from scratch or customized from premium bases. Branded, fast, and conversion-optimized.
- **Payment & Checkout Setup**: Stripe, Shopify Payments, Razorpay, PayPal, and more. Streamlined checkout flows that reduce abandonment.
- **App Integrations**: Klaviyo, Yotpo, ReCharge, Judge.me, Loox, and custom Shopify apps. Every integration your store needs to grow.
- **Shipping & Fulfillment**: ShipStation, Shiprocket, EasyPost, and third-party logistics (3PL) setup. Automated shipping rules and tracking.
- **Product Catalog & Collections**: Bulk product uploads, smart collections, metafields, and variant management. Organized from day one.
- **Analytics & Conversion Tracking**: Google Analytics 4, Meta Pixel, TikTok Pixel, and Shopify analytics dashboards. Know exactly what's selling.
- **Shopify Markets & Internationalization**: Multi-currency, multi-language stores powered by Shopify Markets. Sell globally from a single backend.

## Supported Technologies & Frameworks
- Shopify
- Shopify Plus
- Liquid
- Hydrogen
- Klaviyo
- Yotpo
- ReCharge
- Judge.me
- Stripe
- Razorpay
- PayPal
- ShipStation

## Delivery & Engineering Process
01. **Discovery & Store Strategy**: Define your product catalog, target audience, branding, and conversion goals.
02. **Theme & UX Design**: Custom Shopify theme wireframes and interactive prototypes optimized for mobile conversions.
03. **Store Build & App Setup**: Liquid theme engineering, payment gateways, shipping rules, and marketing app integrations.
04. **Testing & QA**: End-to-end checkout testing, speed optimization, and cross-browser quality checks.
05. **Launch & Handoff**: Domain connection, live checkout verification, and store management training.
